sources.title: Draft London Plan consultation accessible online event
sources.verified_claim: City Hall's 22 July consultation event confirms the Draft London Plan remains under consultation until 5pm on 15 October 2026 and covers housing, transport, environment and economic development; draft proposals are not adopted parcel policy.

sources.title: MD3485 Treasury Management Strategy Statement 2026-27
sources.verified_claim: The 2026-27 treasury strategy states Housing and Land investments include loans and recoverable grants and that CHDIF is intended to intervene in projects that otherwise would not proceed, while programme risk must be identified and provided for.

sources.title: Housing and land publications
sources.verified_claim: City Hall's live housing-and-land publication catalogue lists current 2026 funding guidance and programme documents, providing a traceable official source index rather than parcel-level delivery evidence.

sources.title: Search for funding
sources.verified_claim: City Hall's funding search shows active housing programmes including CHDIF and the 2026-36 affordable-homes programme, but eligibility and open status do not establish an award to any sample parcel.

sources.title: Evidence base for the Local Development Plan
sources.verified_claim: Havering's official evidence catalogue identifies housing, transport, open-space, viability, infrastructure and Rainham/Beam Park planning-framework evidence supporting the adopted plan; document dates vary and must not be treated uniformly as current.

sources.title: Topic papers
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's official topic papers cover affordable housing, small sites, workspace, town centres, climate change, tall buildings and housing provision; they are policy evidence, not exact intersection evidence.

sources.title: Environment evidence base
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's environment evidence page lists flood, surface-water, air-quality, waste and green-infrastructure evidence with several documents originating before 2021, so evidence-age limitations are retained explicitly.

sources.title: Local Plan examination library - From the Local Authority
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's examination library records statutory supporting and evidence documents, including infrastructure and viability material, providing provenance and publication-history context rather than current parcel conclusions.
